business.headline: Buying gold jewellery or luxury bag as investment? Radhika Gupta has a warningRadhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, separated what she called physical investments from financial investments, and urged investors to think about how easily an asset can actually be converted into money when they need it.

Don't buy crypto in India: Radhika Gupta's blunt advice to investorsAt the India Today Woman Summit 2026, Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, told investors not to buy crypto in India. She said the concern was less about the asset and more about weak regulatory, tax and investor recourse safeguards.

Cracks, questions and a changing guard at TataThe Tata name has spent more than a century building an empire that touches almost every part of Indian life. But as the group prepares for a change at the top, several of its biggest businesses are demanding very different things at the same time.

Rs 5 crore, Rs 10 crore or Rs 40 crore: How much is enough to retire?Radhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, said people should stop fixating on a Rs 40 crore retirement target. She said retirement planning should begin with projected expenses and disciplined investing, not intimidating headline numbers.

Radhika Gupta 10-30-50 rule for women: How much to invest in your 20s, 30s, 40sRadhika Gupta, MD & CEO of Edelweiss Mutual Fund, outlined a 10-30-50 investing rule for women at the India Today Woman Summit 2026. She said automatic SIPs, basic protection and simple diversification matter more than chasing complexity.

Economic regulations worse than 1991, no Manmohan Singh to bail us out: ChidambaramFormer finance minister P Chidambaram criticised India's current economic model, saying regulations were worse than in 1991 and the country lacked an economic brain like Manmohan Singh. He questioned the manufacturing push, limited FTAs and shrinking competition, while calling for stronger domestic manufacturing and a more competitive economy.

India receives Rs 4,895 crore FDI after easing rules for neighbouring countriesThe government said the investments cover sectors such as information technology, artificial intelligence, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, data centres and transport services.

Sugar gets costlier ahead of festivals: Govt rules out ethanol as the reasonAccording to government data, the price of sugar increased from Rs 48.18 per kg on July 20, 2026, to Rs 55.70 per kg on August 20.

The next UPI innovation won't be faster payments, it will be safer paymentsAs fraudsters become more sophisticated, industry experts believe the next phase of UPI's growth will be built around trust, smarter fraud detection and security that works quietly in the background.

India plans $1.2 billion manufacturing push to reduce China machinery dependenceIndia is finalising a $1.2 billion incentive scheme to spur local production of tunnel boring machines and other construction equipment, aimed at reducing supply risks linked to China while supporting the country's infrastructure build-out.

SBI cash withdrawals to cost more from October 1: What customers need to knowSBI has revised cash withdrawal charges for eligible BSBD accounts opened through branches from October 1, 2026. The change keeps four monthly withdrawals free but raises costs for customers who rely on cash more often.

Housing prices rise 6% in India: Check cities which saw the sharpest riseHousing prices across India rose 6% year-on-year in 1QFY27, with Bengaluru and Hyderabad leading the increase. A report underlines how stronger demand, better connectivity and premium housing are pushing up values even as sales volumes grow modestly.

Cognizant alerts customers over data breach, offers $1 million identity theft coverThe company has asked affected customers to consider filing a police report and placing a security freeze on their credit reports.

Sensex ends flat as financial stocks offset crude and bond yield concernsThe BSE Sensex ended at 77,540.83, up 3.11 points, or 0.004%, while the Nifty 50 settled at 24,252.00, up just 20 points at the closing bell.

Has India lost the AI race? NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant answersFormer NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant said India has not lost the AI race and can build strength through talent and data centres. He said the bigger opportunity lies in applying AI across sectors while reshaping skilling for future jobs.

LIC gets green light from RBI to raise HDFC Bank stake to nearly 10%The Reserve Bank of India has allowed LIC to raise its HDFC Bank stake up to 9.99%. The approval gives LIC the room to buy more shares.

Why every fintech needs a fraud strategy before a growth strategyFor fintechs, growth is exciting, but it can also attract a growing fraud problem. As scams become smarter, companies need to build strong fraud defences before they chase the next wave of customers.

Tata Sons succession search moves into action, meetings begin to find next chiefTata Trusts chairman Noel Tata met former HDFC chairman Deepak Parekh in Mumbai as Tata Trusts begin shaping the committee to pick Tata Sons' next chairman. The move sets the succession process in motion after N Chandrasekaran decided not to seek another term.
Gold, silver jump over 5% this week: Is it still the right time to buy?With gold and silver climbing this week, investors face a tough call: chase the rally, hold their positions or cash out?

When does EPF stop earning interest? EPFO explains rules for inoperative accountsAn old EPF account should not be forgotten just because you have moved to a new job. Knowing its status can help you keep track of your retirement savings and avoid problems when you eventually want to access the money.

entertainment.headline: Thought he was mad: Dil Raju on Yash working with Geetu Mohandas for Toxic after KGF Speaking at Toxic's Hyderabad pre-release event, producer Dil Raju revealed he initially questioned Yash's choice of director Geetu Mohandas after KGF, but later praised both Yash's vision and the film's visuals.

Case against Toxic team, Malla Reddy university after 4 injured at pre-release event Cyberabad Police have registered a case after a speaker stand collapsed at the Toxic pre-release event in Medchal, injuring four people. The mishap halted actor Yash's speech twice as organisers were asked to help the injured and stop fans climbing other stands.

Ajith Kumar escapes unhurt after high-speed car crash during race in Europe. Report Actor Ajith Kumar escaped unhurt after his car lost control and hit another vehicle during a Europe endurance race. The latest incident adds to a string of racing crashes from which he has previously walked away safely.

Ranveer Singh reflects on tough box-office phase before Dhurandhar's success Actor Ranveer Singh has spoken about the difficult phase in his career before Dhurandhar became a massive hit. He said the backing he received during that patch made the franchise's success especially meaningful.

Toxic release date, runtime, cast: Everything to know about Yash's gangster-drama Yash's Toxic: A Fairytale For Grown-Ups is set for a worldwide theatrical release on August 26. Here's everything you need to know about the film, including its runtime, certification, release details, cast, characters, story and key crew.

Film and TV actor Aasha Singh Jaiswal dies in Mumbai Veteran actor, social worker and mimicry artist Aasha Singh Jaiswal died at around 7:30 pm on August 22. Her son Akkash Bharadwaj remembered her as an iron lady and asked people to pray for her soul and remember her work.

Yash defends Toxic amid backlash, says women will have a blast watching it At Toxic's pre-release event, Yash defended the film against criticism over its portrayal of women. He said the trailer has been misunderstood and urged audiences, especially women, to watch the full film before judging it.

Taapsee Pannu shares cryptic post following Kangana Ranaut's 'sasti copy' jibe Actor Taapsee Pannu shared a cryptic caption on social media after actor-politician Kangana Ranaut's deleted "sasti copy" swipe. The exchange has revived a years-long public feud over upbringing, rivalry and industry barbs.

Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai's Mohsin Khan gets engaged to longtime partner Tamanna Actor Mohsin Khan announced his engagement to longtime partner Tamanna with photos from an intimate ceremony. His heartfelt note and congratulatory messages from television colleagues drew attention online.

Can never be enough of Salman Khan, Sanjay Dutt: 7 Dogs directors on stars' cameos Directors Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah said working with Salman Khan and Sanjay Dutt on 7 Dogs introduced them to contemporary Indian cinema. The directors said the Mumbai shoot, 360-degree action sequence and fan frenzy deepened their interest in making a project in India.

Govinda issues legal notice over defamatory reports, threatens Rs 100 crore action Govinda has issued a public notice warning against false and unverified content about him and his family. The move comes amid attention on his marriage and claims involving AI-manipulated material.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 9: Emraan film jumps 43.5%, nears Rs 200 crore milestone Awarapan 2 has surprisingly surged at the box office, nearing a Rs 200-crore global gross. Despite a modest start, the Emraan Hashmi starrer has connected deeply with audiences familiar with the original, making it a strong commercial success globally.

Yash's Toxic crosses Rs 27 crore in advance bookings, 4 lakh tickets sold Yash's Toxic has crossed Rs 27 crore in domestic advance bookings ahead of its August 26 release. Karnataka is leading demand, with Kannada 2D driving pre-sales as trade watches for a late surge.

Yash pauses speech after sound box setup collapses at Toxic event, 2 injured Yash's speech at the Hyderabad pre-release event of Toxic was interrupted after a sound box setup collapsed near students, leaving two injured. The incident briefly shifted attention from the film's promotions to crowd safety at the packed venue.

Sasti copy is out: Kangana Ranaut slams Taapsee Pannu over 'upbringing' remark Actor Taapsee Pannu recently stated that she has never met actor-politician Kangana Ranaut despite their public history. The comments drew a sharp social media response from Kangana, reigniting their long-standing 'sasti copy' feud.

Deepika Padukone 'would never collaborate' with Sandeep Reddy Vanga, claims source Fresh claims surrounding actor Deepika Padukone's meeting with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga have brought her Spirit exit back into the spotlight. The new revelations reignite a long-running row over her departure from the film.

Govinda visits Juhu hospital amid feud with Ssunita Ahuja, addresses health concern Actor Govinda was seen outside a Juhu hospital amid his public dispute with Ssunita Ahuja and renewed attention on their marriage. The actor interacted with the paparazzi, who asked him about his health as he exited.

You drive me crazy, Kareena Kapoor tells paps, laughs off pregnancy rumours Actor Kareena Kapoor appeared to brush aside pregnancy rumours sparked by a gym video that surfaced online. Her humorous social media post came after denial from her sister-in-law Saba Pataudi amid the viral claims.

Kareena, Dhanush set to feature in Bhansali's mythological film? Director responds Director PS Mithran said talks are underway for a Sanjay Leela Bhansali-backed film with Kareena Kapoor Khan and Dhanush. The reported project could mark multiple firsts, including Mithran's Hindi directorial debut and Kareena's first collaboration with Bhansali since Devdas.

general news.headline: Caught taking drugs, men kill Hindu family; stay home to eat, bathe after murdersTwo men killed a Hindu family of four in Bangladesh after allegedly being confronted over drug use on their rooftop. After the killings, they stayed inside the home for hours, ate dates and cucumbers, and took a bath.

Represented India abroad, now ex-diplomat asked to prove citizenship during SIRNavdeep Suri, who served as India's ambassador to the United Arab Emirates and Egypt and as high commissioner to Australia, encountered the problem during the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls in Punjab.

Record Rs 92 crore spent on Union Ministers' Delhi homes repair in 2025-26: RTIAn RTI reply shows spending on Union Ministers' official bungalow repairs in Delhi hit Rs 92.35 crore in 2025-26. The sharp rise, which tripled in 11 years, highlights the mounting cost of maintaining ageing colonial-era residences.

Why Turkish military planes made repeated Pakistan trips in 3 daysMultiple Turkish C-130 aircraft were observed shuttling between Turkey and Pakistan over three days. The repeated trips have sharpened attention on suspected drone and air-defence transfers to Islamabad.

Kujur, Gurindervir humbled at home before Asian Games. And that is a good thingAnimesh Kujur and Gurindervir Singh were humbled at home in Bhubaneswar, but their defeat could prove to be exactly what they needed before the Asian Games. For India's leading sprinters, the Continental Tour in Bhubaneshwar, was in some ways, the perfect preparation they needed.

Before Maharashtra family suicide, mother posted video alleging family harassmentSangita Chandgude, who died along with her husband and 18-year-old son after the three fell from a hill in Waluj on Friday, had shared a video on YouTube a day before the tragedy. In the video, she spoke about giving love and making sacrifices only for people who value them.

Air hostess-turned-cop untraceable after FIR in Madhya Pradesh land dealPachisia, a former air hostess who later joined the police force, was attending a departmental training programme in Bhopal from August 18 to 20 when the FIR was registered. She allegedly left after learning about the case and has not been traced since.

Gavaskar, Kapil among 21 ex-captains in fresh appeal to Pak PM over Imran's healthA group of 21 former international captains, including Kapil Dev and Sunil Gavaskar, has urged Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to ensure proper medical care for Imran Khan. They called for the Supreme Court-ordered medical assessment and weekly family visits to be carried out without interruption and with dignity.

At 7, he built a website. At 16, a satellite. Then came $4.3M: Meet Onkar Singh BatraJammu-born entrepreneur Onkar Singh Batra is building Apolink, a satellite relay company tackling communication gaps in low Earth orbit. An intern at IIT and a Guiness world record holder, Batra is now on the path to becoming an inspiration for many more.

Instagram ad promises Ahmedabad man a date, dupes him of Rs 9.5 lakhA 24-year-old Ahmedabad PG resident told police he lost Rs 9.50 lakh after responding to an Instagram advertisement promising a meeting with a young woman. The case is now with the Cyber Crime Branch, which is tracing the phone number and bank accounts linked to the alleged fraud.

The latents in Samay Raina's show who remained latentThey were counting on a few minutes on Samay Raina's India's Got Latent to boost their following and earnings. The episode got recorded but was never aired after the Ranveer Allahbadia controversy last year. We spoke to two such participants whose episodes never aired, and who, like a dozen participants with them, remained latent.

15 months on, Jaish rebuilds Bahawalpur base hit by India during Op SindoorThe reconstruction of Jaish-e-Mohammed's (JeM) Markaz Subhan Allah headquarters in Pakistan's Bahawalpur, damaged in India's Operation Sindoor strikes last May, has been completed, exclusive visuals accessed by India Today TV show. The camp has been restored with new marble, fresh paint and plaster, with damaged domes rebuilt.

Live worm found in food at high-end Gurugram restaurantAn Instagram video showed a live worm crawling over food served at Paul's in Gurugram. The post triggered alarm over the hygiene standards of the high-end eatery.

In body parts on train case, cops follow CCTV trail to Chennai house of horrorsPolice probing a woman's body parts found in a red suitcase on a train in Agra on August 6 have reached a rented Chennai house belonging to the accused. CCTV footage, railway records and forensic tests are key to identifying the victim and the two suspects.

150 Pakistani Sindhi brides cross visa hurdle, fly to India for weddingsAfter visa curbs and the Attari closure, 150 Pakistani Sindhi brides reached India through overseas transit routes for their weddings. The arrivals have brought relief to separated families, even as nearly 300 more women await similar visas.

Defiant Iran mocks 'desperate' US sanctions threat, says pressure will failIranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Washington appeared to be returning to familiar tactics after its military campaign against Tehran had failed to achieve its intended objectives.

They spy on India from space. Now an Indian startup is ready to expose themDigantara is developing MOSAIC, an autonomous system to detect and track objects moving above India. The effort reflects a wider push to build independent space awareness as satellite activity grows.
Question Time: Weekly News QuizThink you read the headlines this week? Let's test that!

Meet the IIT Bombay engineer who turned down ISRO to build Rs 1,000 crore AtombergIIT Bombay alumnus Manoj Meena had an ISRO job waiting after graduation. Instead, he chose entrepreneurship and spent four years searching for a scalable idea. A breakthrough in energy-efficient motors eventually led to Atomberg, which crossed Rs 1,000 crore in total income in FY25.

Drop IFS officers from rural development posts: NDA ally leader to Tamil Nadu govtPMK president Anbumani Ramadoss, whose party is a part of NDA, has demanded the Tamil Nadu government to revoke the posting of IFS officers as District Rural Development Agency project directors. He said the move could weaken rural administration, disrupt village services and demoralise the department cadre.

From tribal chutney to tasting menus: How ants went gourmet in IndiaIndian chefs and bartenders are bringing ants and other insects into tasting menus and cocktails. The shift draws on long-standing tribal food knowledge rather than treating the ingredient as a novelty.

House help's husband joins her at work when she is unwell. People raise questionsAn Instagram video showed a house help's husband accompanying her to work and helping in the kitchen when she was unwell. The comments section had both appreciation for the gesture and questions about him assisting her.

Back women's quota law, sing full Vande Mataram: Smriti Irani dares Rahul GandhiHer remarks came a day after Gandhi asked girl students to "smash patriarchy" during his 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' outreach programme in Pune.

Fish feast at Congress's Ayodhya event sparks row, party leader defends food choiceThe seers' criticism came amid heightened religious activity in Ayodhya during Sawan, when devotees undertake pilgrimages and visit temples across the city. Hanuman Garhi is one of the prominent religious sites in Ayodhya and attracts a large number of devotees.

sports.headline: India Open to move to Guwahati in 2028, Delhi to host 2027 and 2029 The India Open will leave Delhi for Guwahati in 2028, with Republic Day logistics prompting the one-year shift, while the tournament stays in the capital in 2027 after being moved to February.

Yuzvendra Chahal joins 6-7 trend, recreates Medhavi Bidhuri's viral celebration Yuzvendra Chahal recreated Delhi cricketer Medhavi Bidhuri's viral '6-7' celebration after dismissing Joe Moores during Northamptonshire's County Championship clash against Lancashire.

Shahbaz, Gharami save East Zone after Vaibhav's failure, coaches under scanner Sudip Gharami and Shahbaz Ahmed pulled East Zone out of trouble against North East on the opening day of the Duleep Trophy quarter-final. In Bengaluru, North Zone's call to leave out Sanat Sangwan despite his Ranji form drew immediate scrutiny.

India batting coach shares blunt response on Kuldeep Yadav's Colombo Test omission SL vs IND, 2nd Test: India batting coach Sitanshu Kotak dismissed speculation over whether Kuldeep Yadav would have played in Colombo if fit. Kuldeep missed the Test due to illness, while India took control after reaching 300 for five on Day 1.

2nd Test: India score 300 on Day 1, but Gautam Gambhir might not be happy India finished with 300 runs for the loss of 5 wickets on Day 1 of the second Test. While the score might be a good one, but coach Gautam Gambhir will not be happy, believe ex-India cricketers.

India, Sri Lanka react as Jaiswal faces potential ICC sanction after physical altercation Sri Lanka vs India, Colombo Test: Yashasvi Jaiswal could face ICC sanctions after his helmet made contact with Asitha Fernando's forehead during a heated altercation with the Sri Lankan pacer following his dismissal on Sunday.

East Bengal thrash arch-rivals Mohun Bagan to win record-equalling 17th Durand Cup East Bengal produced a stunning performance in the Kolkata derby, beating arch-rivals Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4-1 to win the Durand Cup for a record-equalling 17th time at the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan on Sunday.

Rishabh Pant fit to bat in Colombo Test? Sitanshu Kotak shares injury update India batting coach Sitanshu Kotak confirmed Rishabh Pant will be fit to bat on Day 2 after retiring hurt with a wrist injury. India ended Day 1 at 300/5, with Devdutt Padikkal's 117 putting the visitors in control against Sri Lanka.

Gavaskar, Kapil among 21 ex-captains in fresh appeal to Pak PM over Imran's health A group of 21 former international captains, including Kapil Dev and Sunil Gavaskar, has urged Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to ensure proper medical care for Imran Khan. They called for the Supreme Court-ordered medical assessment and weekly family visits to be carried out without interruption and with dignity.

An Se Young wins 2nd World Championships title, continues love affair with India An Se Young swept aside Akane Yamaguchi to win her second World Championships title, extending her unbeaten record in India as Delhi's favourite celebrated another golden chapter.

Colombo Test: Devdutt Padikkal's encore helps India overcome early wobbles on Day 1 Sri Lanka vs India Colombo Test, Day 1: Devdutt Padikkal followed his Galle heroics with another hundred as India took control on Day 1 in Colombo. His 117 steadied India after early setbacks, before a late Sri Lanka fightback and Rishabh Pant's injury added intrigue.

History at BWF Worlds: Alex Lanier wins France's first-ever singles gold medalBWF World Championships 2026: It was a historic day for France in Delhi as Thom Gicquel-Delphine Delrue won gold before 21-year-old Alex Lanier stunned Kodai Naraoka to become France's first men's singles World champion.

Sprinter with fractured foot named in Indian contingent for Asian GamesIndia have announced a 492-member strong contingent for the Asian Games 2026. The list has hurdler Tejas Shirse named in it, who suffered stress fractures in his foot during the Commonwealth Games.

167 in Galle, hundred in SSC: Devdutt Padikkal cements himself as India's Test No. 3Devdutt Padikkal is making a compelling case for himself as India's long-term No. 3 after producing back-to-back centuries in the two-Test series against Sri Lanka. He followed up his 167 in the first Test in Galle with a composed hundred at the Sinhalese Sports Club Ground.

Rishabh Pant walks off retired hurt after wrist injury in Colombo TestRishabh Pant retired hurt after being struck on the left wrist by a Lahiru Kumara short ball in India's first innings in Colombo. The setback came just after tea and added to India's concerns despite a strong recovery led by Shubman Gill and Devdutt Padikkal.

India leg-spinner Karn Sharma retires from international, domestic cricketIndia leg-spinner Karn Sharma has announced his retirement from international and domestic cricket at 38, bringing the curtain down on a career that included four international appearances and three IPL titles with three different teams.

Sri Lanka seek more Tests against India, England and Australia in FTP revampSri Lanka Cricket interim committee chairman Eran Wickramaratne on Sunday called for a revamp of the ICC's Future Tours Programme to give Sri Lanka more opportunities to play Test cricket against top teams such as India, England and Australia.

Bangladesh suffer Aussie fury as Starc's 10-wicket haul mauls toothless TigersMitchell Starc unleashed a stunning display of fast bowling as Australia bounced back from their shock defeat in Darwin, dismantling Bangladesh by an innings and 51 runs in the second Test in Mackay to level the series.

Yashasvi Jaiswal headbutts Asitha Fernando after dismissal as tempers flareSL vs IND: Yashasvi Jaiswal and Asitha Fernando exchanged words after the India opener was dismissed for 45 in Colombo. Team-mates stepped in quickly as Sri Lanka fought back after India's brisk start.

Vaibhav Sooryavanshi out for 8 on Duleep Trophy debut as vice-captainVaibhav Sooryavanshi's first outing as East Zone vice-captain lasted just six balls in Bengaluru. The teenage batter struck two boundaries before falling for eight, ending his much-anticipated red-ball audition on a disappointing note.

Saransh Jain makes Test debut in Colombo at 33, Kuldeep Yadav misses outIND vs SL: Saransh Jain finally received his maiden India Test cap at 33 after years of domestic consistency. His debut in Colombo came as Kuldeep Yadav missed out with an infection, adding another twist to India's spin selection.

8,000 fans at a badminton carnival. How Delhi smashed the doubts at BWF WorldsAs many as 8,000 fans packed Delhi's IGI Stadium on the semifinals day, turning the BWF World Championships into a badminton carnival. They came for stars, found new heroes and smashed doubts about Delhi's appetite for badminton.

Day 1 Highlights: Jadeja falls in final over, but India in command after Day 1India (IND) vs Sri Lanka (SL) Highlights, 2nd Test Day 1: IND (300/5 in 85 overs). Ravindra Jadeja became the last wicket to fall on Day 1 for the visiting side. The Shubman Gill side was put in command by a strong century from Devdutt Padikkal, who continued his sensational form in the series.

Men's Hockey World Cup: How India can still reach the semifinalsIndia still have a route to the Hockey World Cup semifinals, but they need to beat Argentina and hope the Netherlands defeat England, with goal difference and field goals potentially deciding their fate

Shoriful Islam scripts history with seven-wicket haul vs Australia in Mackay TestAUS vs BAN: Shoriful Islam produced Bangladesh's best away Test bowling figures with 7/48 on Day 2 in Mackay. His record spell helped bowl Australia out for 210 and gave Bangladesh a 146-run first-innings lead.

Gianni Infantino's FIFA rift deepens after defying vice president's requestGianni Infantino attended a Caribbean youth tournament despite Victor Montagliani asking him to stay away. The visit has sharpened a wider FIFA governance dispute over the shelved investor plan and his leadership.

Kujur, Gurindervir humbled at home before Asian Games. And that is a good thingAnimesh Kujur and Gurindervir Singh were humbled at home in Bhubaneswar, but their defeat could prove to be exactly what they needed before the Asian Games. For India's leading sprinters, the Continental Tour in Bhubaneshwar, was in some ways, the perfect preparation they needed.

Australia vs Bangladesh, 2nd Test Day 2: Highlights from MackayAUS vs BAN, 2nd Test Day 2 Highlights: Australia levelled the Test series in emphatic fashion as Mitchell Starc's 10-wicket haul helped them seal an innings-and-51-run win over Bangladesh inside two days.

His daughter won a World Champs medal. But Gopichand kept his coach's hat onFor a brief moment, Pullela Gopichand was both father and coach. As Gayatri and Treesa Jolly made history in Delhi, the coach spoke first. The father revealed himself only in flashes.

Only after Neeraj: Rohit hits 2nd best throw by Indian, wins Continental TourRohit Yadav produced the biggest throw of his career, hurling the javelin 87.68m at the Continental Tour Silver meet in Bhubaneswar. The mark puts him only second best to Neeraj Chopra in India.

Lunch plans, ice-cream: How Gayatri and Treesa plan to celebrate BWF Worlds medalBWF World Championships: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand won bronze in the women's doubles after losing to defending champions Liu Sheng Shu and Tan Ning in the semifinals on Saturday in New Delhi.

education.headline: The role of data analytics in modern advertising educationThis transformation also exercises a significant impact on the realm of 'advertising education.'

NCERT deletes Azad Pak, adds China's aggression reference in Class 12 textbookThe NCERT has made final changes to its Class 12 Political Science textbook syllabus for the upcoming academic year, including a revision in reference to India's border situation with China, Azad Pakistan, Article 370 and more.

NEET row: Bihar cops find 6 post-dated cheques 'issued for question paper brokers'Six post-dated cheques which were suspected to have been issued in favour of mafia demanding over Rs 30 lakh from each candidate seeking alleged leaked question paper ahead of NEET held last month were recovered by Bihar Police.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Year by year, their fiery grip tightens, threatening ecosystems far and wide, now extending their reach to impact human lives.

Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

NTA issues clarification after NEET result controversy over toppers, high cut-offIn a detailed statement, the National Testing Agency (NTA) said that the increase in cut-off and number of toppers in the NEET-UG reflect the competitive nature of the exam and maintained that the test's integrity has not been compromised.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. He also claimed that the ruling party is "not fighting the Lok Sabha elections as a team".

4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

NEET-UG question paper not leaked, claims baseless: National Testing AgencyThe reports claiming question paper leak in the medical entrance exam NEET-UG are "completely baseless and without any ground", the National Testing Agency (NTA) has clarified.
The generation with answers: Tech-savvy Indian youth tackling global challengesIndia's tech-savvy youth rewriting the global narrative, one solution at a time.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. The ABVP was leading at one point, but the Left eventually surged ahead and emerged victorious.
The power of knowledge: Education's influence on real estate market trendsIn a dynamic sector like real estate, investing in continuing education is not simply an option; it is a requirement.

JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.

UP Police Constable recruitment exam cancelled days after paper leakThe Uttar Pradesh Police Constable recruitment exam held on February 17 and 18 was canceled due to a paper leak. The Chief Minister has announced a re-examination within the next six months.
Exam scams | Plugging the leaksA new central legislation aims to end the old scourge of exam paper scams for govt jobs, with heavy punishment and penalties
The brave new totsTutotials teaching children how to take on a highly competitive world are mushrooming in the city

Coaching | Kota factory, season 2While online ed-tech companies eye the brick-and-mortar world of coaching centres in the city, traditional institutes are extending their digital arms to remain on top of the game
India Today Education Conclave 2022: All bets on edutechThe India Today Education Conclave 2022 touched on topics like early childhood care, universal education, the NEP and India’s edutech boom
Courting ChristiansSt Stephen's College rules come under fire.
